correctness.rationale: For every finite complete multipartite graph, the coordinate clearing condition is x_v+sum_{j != part(v)}sum_{u in P_j}x_u=1 over F2. Comparing two vertices in one part shows their press indicators coincide. The reduced equation (1+epsilon_i)y_i+t=1, t=sum epsilon_j y_j, gives exactly the two claimed regimes and all weight coefficients. Its homogeneous variant gives binary nullity max(o-1,0), verifying universal-solvability and extremality boundaries. Minimum sizes and multiplicities follow from positivity of part sizes. The included independent direct Gray-code enumerator verifies 363 profiles and all 579194 candidate press subsets, with GF2 rank cross-check; these experiments are supportive only.

value.rationale: The current motivating literature studies extremality of all-on Lights Out, while minimization of presses on arbitrary graphs is difficult. This theorem classifies every clearing press set and all sizes for all positive multipartite profiles, giving a closed weight polynomial, sharp minimum and optimizer census, closed-neighborhood nullity and an explicit extremality threshold. Arbitrarily large even parts become irrelevant as soon as an odd part exists, a nontrivial global structural distinction. The result is a natural complete structural classification, not an arbitrary finite parameter evaluation; standard field-linear-algebra ingredients are duly credited.
